reviewSamples.author: Photo of D G-S
reviewSamples.text: A little pricey, but would come back. The breakfast sandwiches were delicious, coffee was nice and hot, and we didn’t have to wait more than 10 mins for our food. The inside is a bit small, but get there early if you don’t wanna be cramped. The service was great too.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Brigitte Krahn
reviewSamples.text: The food and coffee is incredibly good, and their staff us super kind! It’s more of a grab and go kind of shop, and not as much of a sit down and enjoy the atmosphere one, but it is super nice regardless. I’m SO coming back next time I’m in Clearwater Beach. (If you like cinnamon, you HAVE to get the Cinnamon muffin!!)
